name: mf_sc_noise
description: A collection of noise UGens from supercollider conceptually ported to MayaFlux Nodes

name: mf_follow
description: Envelope following for audio: attack/release peak and RMS kernels in Kinesis, a block-level EnvelopeProcessor with feature, signal and gain outputs and sidechain input, and a per-sample EnvelopeFollower node.

name: mf_vocalic
description: Records a voice through a buffer pipeline and splits it into vowel and consonant streams on the GPU: a Yantra grammar (Vocalic::Classify | Vocalic::Separate) of an Analyzer and an Extractor running ShaderSpec compute kernels, a BufferPipeline recorder, and TapSet playback of the two streams.
